# Supported methods

This page is generated from the live model registry and checked method metadata. Availability on one machine still depends on optional packages and local assets; the app reports that separately.

| Key | Method | Family | Maturity | Resume | ONNX/export |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `pixel_reference` | Pixel reference (baseline) | statistical reference | supported | no | onnx |
| `efficientad_custom` | EfficientAD (ours) | student–teacher + reconstruction | supported | yes | onnx |
| `patchcore_anomalib` | PatchCore (anomalib) | feature memory bank | supported | no | onnx |
| `dinomaly_anomalib` | Dinomaly (anomalib) | transformer feature reconstruction | supported | yes | onnx |
| `glass_anomalib` | GLASS (experimental) | learned anomaly synthesis | experimental | yes | onnx |
| `dino_memory` | DINO patch memory | frozen-backbone patch memory | experimental | no | — |

**Maturity is an evidence decision, not an upstream popularity label.** Experimental methods remain usable for research but have not cleared this workbench's public promotion gate.

## Pixel reference (baseline)

`pixel_reference` · **statistical reference** · supported

Per-pixel median and MAD over the training normals, then a smoothed robust z-map. Trains in seconds on CPU and gives every deep result a floor to beat.

- Preferred device: `cpu`
- Requires fitting: yes
- Anomaly map: yes
- Diagnostics: yes
- Exact continuation: no
- Dataset-specific: no
- Portable formats: onnx

## EfficientAD (ours)

`efficientad_custom` · **student–teacher + reconstruction** · supported

Our implementation of student-teacher distillation with an autoencoder branch, measured against the anomalib version rather than copied from it.

- Preferred device: `mps`
- Requires fitting: yes
- Anomaly map: yes
- Diagnostics: yes
- Exact continuation: yes
- Dataset-specific: no
- Portable formats: onnx

## PatchCore (anomalib)

`patchcore_anomalib` · **feature memory bank** · supported

A coreset memory bank of patch features from a frozen ImageNet backbone, scored by nearest-neighbour distance. Nothing is trained; the bank is the model.

- Preferred device: `mps`
- Requires fitting: yes
- Anomaly map: yes
- Diagnostics: yes
- Exact continuation: no
- Dataset-specific: no
- Portable formats: onnx

## Dinomaly (anomalib)

`dinomaly_anomalib` · **transformer feature reconstruction** · supported

A frozen DINOv2 encoder with a trainable transformer decoder that reconstructs normal feature maps; reconstruction disagreement becomes the anomaly map.

- Preferred device: `mps`
- Requires fitting: yes
- Anomaly map: yes
- Diagnostics: no
- Exact continuation: yes
- Dataset-specific: no
- Portable formats: onnx

## GLASS (experimental)

`glass_anomalib` · **learned anomaly synthesis** · experimental

A frozen WRN-50 feature extractor with learned global and local anomaly synthesis. Its bounded public gate missed the image-level promotion floor; keep it as an experimental learned-synthesis comparison.

- Preferred device: `mps`
- Requires fitting: yes
- Anomaly map: yes
- Diagnostics: no
- Exact continuation: yes
- Dataset-specific: no
- Portable formats: onnx

## DINO patch memory

`dino_memory` · **frozen-backbone patch memory** · experimental

A frozen DINOv2/DINOv3 backbone whose patch features are held as a memory of normal images and scored globally, per position, or as a per-position Gaussian. Nothing is trained; the memory is the model.

- Preferred device: `mps`
- Requires fitting: yes
- Anomaly map: yes
- Diagnostics: yes
- Exact continuation: no
- Dataset-specific: no
- Portable formats: —
